# Triggers & Effects
## Triggers Nodes require specific triggers to activate. Examples: - Harmonical sound vibrations (play a musical instrument) - Close inspection (examine the artifact) - Low pressure (drop pressure below 50 kPa) - Death (kill something nearby) - Physical damage (damage the artifact) - Being thrown (throw the artifact, handheld only) - Blood (splash blood onto the artifact) - Radiation (irradiate the artifact, e.g. uranium weapon) - Magnetic waves (activate magboots nearby) - Water (splash water onto the artifact) - High temperature gas (raise surrounding temperature) - Oxygen-free environment (remove oxygen around the artifact) - High pressure (raise pressure above 300–500 kPa) - Screwing (use a screwdriver on the artifact) - Pulsing (use a multitool on the artifact) - Low temperature gas (cool the surrounding area) - Prying (use a crowbar on the artifact) - Tightening (use a wrench on the artifact) - Carbon dioxide (apply Carbon dioxide) - Non-solid plasma (apply gaseous or liquid plasma) - Nitrous oxide (apply Nitrous oxide) - Regular self-activation (wait for the artifact’s timer) - Tritium (apply tritium) - Frezon (apply frezon) - Ammonia (apply ammonia)
## Effects Activated nodes produce one effect: - [color=green]Harmless:[/color] e.g. spawning plants, animals, or junk - [color=#00ccff]Helpful:[/color] e.g. charging batteries, producing money, generating items - [color=red]Hazardous:[/color] e.g. anomalies, radiation bursts, explosions, hostile fauna
